components.name: Runtime Owner Closure Architecture
components.purpose: Define the neutral architecture rules for future runtime owner closure.
components.evidence_boundary: Requires evidence; does not verify claims.
components.justification: Architecture law must be owned by governance, not runtime.

components.name: Owner Activation Readiness Contract
components.canonical_owner: Package H shared foundation under Governance Layer
components.purpose: Define conceptual readiness responsibilities for future owner activation.
components.justification: Activation readiness must be stable before any implementation path exists.

components.name: Neutral Integration Boundary Register
components.canonical_owner: Master Layer Registry as canonical reference; Governance Layer as charter owner
components.purpose: Ensure future integrations map to existing owners and do not create replacement registries.
components.layer_membership: Governance Layer referencing Master Layer Registry
components.justification: Registry neutrality requires the Master Layer Registry to remain canonical.

components.name: Evidence Trust Envelope
components.canonical_owner: Audit & Verification with Truth Spine and Oracle boundaries preserved
components.purpose: Define conceptual evidence that future runtime closure decisions must produce.
components.runtime_boundary: No audit service or log implementation.
components.data_boundary: No Truth Spine or Oracle data mutation.
components.governance_boundary: Evidence supports certification but does not certify itself.
components.evidence_boundary: Evidence must be objective and validator-linked.
components.justification: Future trust requires evidence while preserving existing verification authorities.

components.name: Runtime Minimalism Guard
components.canonical_owner: Runtime Architecture Authority under Governance Layer
components.purpose: Prevent future Batch 03 architecture from expanding into runtime ownership.
components.justification: Runtime closure must remain minimal and owner-neutral.
